note: Project engineering policy (spec §7.2). Not a NASA rule and not a universal theorem.

covariance.missing_data_rule: amplitude_modulated: scores of missing months are zero and stay at their calendar position; lags are calendar lags (Datta & Du 2012)

annual_inference.note: Raised from the spec starting value of 20 after the calibration study (docs/method-calibration.md): 20-29 annual values over-reject when years are correlated. Shorter annual series are descriptive only.

relative_change.rule: only when the variable concept registers an approved denominator
relative_change.denominator: fixed-baseline mean of the raw series
relative_change.note: below this ratio the mean is too close to zero for a percentage to be meaningful; the percentage is omitted

stability_check: sign of the descriptive slope in the first and second half of the analysis period

monthly_index_metric.rule: a k-month accumulated index (e.g. SPI-k) is autocorrelated by construction over k-1 months; the HAC lag is at least k-1
